summary: Kerjo v3 regression (no-face imagery + optional profile photo upload via Emergent Object Storage). Backend: 34/34 pytest cases pass (extended from 25 by adding TestNoFaceImagery + TestPhotoUpload). Verified: seed workers list & GET /api/workers/wk_1 return avatar=='' (no pravatar/faces); POST /api/upload requires Bearer auth, returns {path,url} for multipart PNG upload (path starts with 'kerjo/uploads/<uid>/'); public GET /api/files/{path} serves the bytes with image/* content-type; missing path -> 404; POST /api/profile {photo_url:<url>} persists and appears as avatar on GET /api/workers/wp_user_A when viewed by tokB; upsert without photo_url PRESERVES existing photo_url (server pops null before $set); a profile with no photo_url has empty avatar. All prior tests still pass: real two-sided match A->B (matched:false then matched:true), cross-account chat, system greeting (no bot auto-reply on real match), employer review attaches to wp_<uid>, solo bot match with greeting+auto-reply, seed count = 10 workers + 10 jobs (owner_user_id=null), category/pay/experience filters, profile CRUD. Frontend web (mobile viewport 390x844, testtoken_kerjo_123): login screen renders red gradient + Kerjo logo + 8 category icon bubbles (NO face images, imgs=0); Cari Kerja swipe deck shows category-colored card with big category icon (no face imgs); Merekrut swipe deck shows worker card w/ category icon + colored top badge (no face imgs); like -> match-overlay shows Kerjo logo + category icon (no faces); worker detail /worker/wk_1 shows teal circle w/ broom icon (no face); profile /profile shows red circle w/ briefcase icon (no face); /onboarding contains 'Unggah Foto' upload option (expo-image-picker). NO red screen. Console warnings unchanged: shadow* deprecation, Animated useNativeDriver on web (non-blocking). ONE ISSUE FOUND: /matches page renders one face image (https://i.pravatar.cc/600?img=5) coming from 3 LEGACY match documents in mongo that were created by earlier iterations when seed workers still had pravatar avatars. The current code path is correct (create_bot_match uses entity.get('avatar','') which is '' for seed workers), but the historical match snapshots persist the old URLs and the frontend renders them.

minor.issue: Legacy match documents from prior iterations still hold pravatar URLs in the 'image' field (bot matches on wk_* seed workers) and in 'worker_avatar' (one real match match_3246fe513dcb). New match creations are correct (image=''), but stale docs make the /matches list show a face image. Migration needed: db.matches.update_many({image:{$regex:'pravatar'}},{$set:{image:''}}) and db.matches.update_many({worker_avatar:{$regex:'pravatar'}},{$set:{worker_avatar:''}}).

ui_bugs.issue: Row thumbnail still renders match.image as an <Image> when it is a non-empty URL. Because legacy match docs carry pravatar URLs, /matches shows a face image on those rows. Preferred fix: in the matches row, if match.image is non-empty AND (match.entity_type==='worker' with an entity_id starting with 'wk_' OR match.image contains 'pravatar') then ignore it and fall back to the CategoryAvatar icon badge. Long-term: run the mongo migration in backend_issues.minor.

issues: Still no testID props on tab-bar items — unchanged from iterations 1 and 2. Not blocking users.

react_native_issues.issue: Web console still logs: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' — repeats on every render. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/cards.tsx and /app/frontend/src/components/swipe-deck.tsx.

Warning: 'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported because the native animated module is missing. Falling back to JS-based animation.' Non-blocking on web; harmless on native. Consider Platform.OS==='web' ? false : true for useNativeDriver.

action_items: One-time mongo migration to clear pravatar URLs from legacy match snapshots: db.matches.update_many({image:{$regex:'pravatar'}},{$set:{image:''}}); db.matches.update_many({worker_avatar:{$regex:'pravatar'}},{$set:{worker_avatar:''}}) — this eliminates the face image showing on /matches for pre-existing bot/real matches.
(Belt-and-suspenders) In the matches row renderer, treat pravatar/randomuser/unsplash-face URLs as empty and fall back to CategoryAvatar so no future regression can leak face imagery.
OPTIONAL: Replace deprecated shadow* style props with boxShadow (or Platform.select) to silence console noise on web.
OPTIONAL: Gate useNativeDriver behind Platform.OS==='web' ? false : true.
NOTE: backend server.py still uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'); migrate to FastAPI lifespan().
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 698 lines — approaching the 700-line split threshold. Consider splitting into routers/auth, routers/browse, routers/matches, routers/profile, routers/uploads.
put_object/get_object make blocking requests inside run_in_threadpool — fine, but consider httpx async client for consistency.

upload_photo does no size limit or magic-byte validation — an authenticated user could upload arbitrary bytes labeled .png. Add a max-size check (e.g. 5 MB) and optionally validate the file signature.

GET /api/files/{path:path} is fully public and proxies whatever bytes the storage returns. That is intentional per spec but note it also serves any object that shares the storage_key — safe here because paths are UUID-suffixed.

rca_of_issue: Symptom: /matches page shows one face image (pravatar) despite the 'no face imagery' spec. Reproduction: seed token -> visit /matches -> DOM contains for the row of match_5d8f1fe0af16 (bot match on wk_1). Root cause: match documents are inserted with a frozen snapshot of the entity's avatar at match-creation time. Iterations 1/2 seeded workers WITH pravatar avatars. Those bot matches persisted image='https://i.pravatar.cc/...'. The v3 refactor emptied seed_data avatars, but historical documents were not migrated. New matches created against the current seed correctly store image=''. Mitigation: (1) one-time mongo update to blank pravatar URLs in db.matches; (2) hardening — filter pravatar/face-host URLs client-side in RowThumb; (3) do not store entity.avatar in the match snapshot at all — always resolve at read time from the current worker doc.
